subject: concurrent calibration with common people as well as items

messages.author: 493ed1dd84ceac5c
messages.subject: concurrent calibration with common people as well as items
parts:
Hello, 

Thank you for all the information you share in this group. I want to use the Rasch model to concurrently estimate item difficulties in the following scenario: I have three test forms, X1, X2, and X3, administered to three different groups. X1 and X2 share common items. X3 does not share any items with either X1 or X2, but it shares common test takers with X2. I believe I should use the multipleGroup function, but I get stuck on the specifics. How can I specify the common people between the groups? 

Kind Regards, 
Eren Asena

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: concurrent calibration with common people as well as items
parts:
Hi Eren,

The planned missingness and common individual design isn't too difficult with multipleGroup(), just make sure that you are imposing suitable equality constraints across the groups for common items that are assumed to have no DIF. The common people do not matter so much, just make sure that the items, which are organized column-wise, contain all the individual responses, which are recorded row-wise. That way the package knows which individuals responded to the same item regardless of their group membership. HTH for now, and feel free to report on how far you get with this approach.

Phil
